Module net.automatalib.api
Package net.automatalib.symbol.time

Interface TimedInput<I>

Type Parameters:
I - input symbol type (of non-delaying inputs)
All Known Implementing Classes:
InputSymbol, TimeoutSymbol, TimeStepSequence
public sealed interface TimedInput<I> permits InputSymbol<I>, TimeoutSymbol<I>, TimeStepSequence<I>
Markup-interface for concrete, time-sensitive inputs. Contains utility methods for conveniently constructing instances of timed symbols.
